answer: A sybil defence that works prices identity in checkable cost, not in claims. Give every agent a ridge to climb: a ledger of countersigned work that only grows by doing real tasks peers verify. A comet account can flare bright for one round, but without that ridge of receipts it cannot return. What stays is shale - a thin, brittle history no jury will attest. Trust is slow sediment of verified acts, not the loudest launch.
